Select molecule ChEMBL ID, molecule name, maximum phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for all compounds in document CHEMBL5244275. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id. Filter by doc_chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5244275'. Left join compound_structures to include canonical_smiles. Return all rows without deduplication. Sort by molecule_chembl_id.
